description: The 'AI writes the app directly' arm of the token benchmark (BENCH comparison). Same prompts (NPDevSamples/ai-bench/prompts), same model, same repair-loop budget as the NPDev arm; only the route differs. The probe contract below is what makes the SAME acceptance probes (scripts/ai/bench/probes.py) runnable against an app NPDev did not generate. It is part of the prompt, so the direct arm is told everything the probes will check -- the comparison must never be won by hiding the test from the competitor.

stacks.label: Python 3.12 stdlib + sqlite3 (single process)
stacks.why: The stack free models write best and boot fastest. This is the steel-man arm: if NPDev does not beat this, it does not beat direct generation.

stacks.label: Node 24 + express + better-sqlite3
stacks.why: The second most common stack in AI-generated apps.

stacks.label: Java 21 + Spring Boot 3 + H2 (like-for-like with NPDev's output)
stacks.why: Same runtime NPDev emits; shows the cost of the code NPDev writes for free. Report it separately -- it is not the headline number.

probeContract: Listen on the port given in the PORT environment variable.
Serve an OpenAPI 3 document at GET /v3/api-docs listing every route.
Expose each kind of record as a REST collection: GET/POST /api/<collection>, GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE /api/<collection>/{id}. JSON bodies, field names in camelCase.

Authenticate every /api request with the X-Api-Key header. The harness passes the keys in the environment as NPDEV_BENCH_ROLE_KEYS, a JSON object {"<role>": "<key>", "admin": "<key>"}; a request whose key's role may not do something gets HTTP 403.
Reject invalid input (missing required field, value outside the allowed list, rule broken) with HTTP 400 or 422 and a JSON body {"error": "<message>"}.
A workflow step named in the prompt is a POST /api/flows/<flowName>/execute with a JSON body; return 200 with the resulting record.
Store data so it survives a restart of the app (a file-backed database).
Do not read or write anything outside the working directory.

evolution: changeTokens: tokens to apply each scripted change request to an already-passing app
changePassRate: change applied AND all previous probes still pass
